explication: Floorp is a Firefox-based desktop browser. A central user-facing workflow represented here is invoking the command palette, searching commands and browser data, then choosing a result; the tree also shows major browser customization and companion-page capabilities. Source excerpts and index references support several internal relationships, but not every feature’s wiring, so unverified links are omitted. The README identifies Firefox as the browser base but does not describe Floorp’s feature-level runtime flows.
